title: Housekeeper
description: Company Description Port Hotel Latvia is a SPA and conference hotel located in a beautiful pine forest in Ādaži, offering a peaceful and scenic environment for guests and staff. The hotel is housed in one of the most striking buildings in the area, designed to resemble a sailing ship, giving it a unique and memorable character. Port Hotel features 29 guest rooms, ranging from simple standard rooms to refined luxury suites, welcoming a variety of travelers. The on-site restaurant “Porto,” spread over two floors, serves traditional European cuisine and special seasonal dishes from September to December, creating a vibrant hospitality setting. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Housekeeper role located in Bahir Dar. The Housekeeper will be responsible for maintaining cleanliness and order in guest rooms, bathrooms, corridors, and public areas, following hotel standards and procedures. Daily tasks include making beds, changing linens, cleaning and disinfecting surfaces, vacuuming and mopping floors, restocking amenities, and handling laundry such as washing, drying, and folding linens and towels. The role also involves reporting maintenance issues, ensuring proper use and storage of cleaning products and equipment, and adhering to health, safety, and hygiene regulations. Housekeepers are expected to interact politely with guests, respond to simple requests, support team members as needed, and contribute to a tidy, welcoming environment throughout the hotel. Qualifications Strong housekeeping skills, including room cleaning, Laundry, and maintaining high hygiene standards. Good Communication and Customer Service skills to interact professionally and courteously with guests and colleagues. Excellent Organization Skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage time and tasks efficiently. Willingness to participate in Training and follow hotel procedures, safety guidelines, and quality standards. Previous experience in housekeeping or hospitality is an advantage. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift moderate weights throughout the shift. Basic understanding of cleaning products and safe handling practices. Reliability, integrity, and a positive attitude toward teamwork and guest satisfaction.

title: Oil Operations Officer
description: Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Employment Type: Full-Time About The Role & Our Client On behalf of our client, People First Consult is looking for an experienced Oil Operations Officer to support petroleum operations across the downstream supply chain. Our client is a diversified Ethiopian private business group with operations across international trade, agribusiness, manufacturing, logistics, and industrial development. The Group has established a strong presence in import and export activities, trading a broad portfolio of commodities including coffee, pulses, oilseeds, livestock, vehicles, food products, and textiles, while continuing to expand into manufacturing and emerging industrial ventures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in petroleum logistics, terminal or depot operations, and a solid understanding of downstream fuel operations. Experience working with an Oil Marketing Company (OMC) is highly desirable. Key Responsibilities Support petroleum product receiving, transfer, loading, and offloading operations. Monitor tank levels, product movement, and inventory while maintaining accurate operational records. Coordinate product allocation and distribution to depots and offtakers. Verify custody transfer measurements and ensure accurate product reconciliation. Prepare daily operational reports, meter readings, and incident documentation. Assist with product sampling, quality checks, and operational compliance. Ensure adherence to HSSE (Health, Safety, Security & Environment) standards. Collaborate with terminal personnel and other stakeholders to support efficient operations. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Transport & Logistics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field. Minimum 2–3 years of experience in petroleum operations, terminal operations, depot operations, or downstream fuel logistics. Previous experience with an Oil Marketing Company (OMC) is a strong advantage. Good understanding of petroleum product handling, logistics coordination, and inventory management. Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and reporting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and data management tools. If you're looking to grow your career in Ethiopia's downstream petroleum industry and have a passion for operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.
